RecordingStartLevel.description:
The lowest level of an App's governed Space whose members may start and stop
recordings. `member` means everyone in the Space. Stored as its wire string.

oneOf.description: Nobody through the App's levels (the default; roles and overwrites still apply).

description:
An App's recording settings, in the answer of `GET`/`POST /mgmt/v1/apps/{app_id}/settings`
(left out while every field has its default).

audio_max_days.description: The App's cap on audio keep days; absent: the org's.

cap_required.description: The App's sessions need `voice:record` to start or stop (default `false`).

required.description: Every call with two or more people is recorded (default `false`).

server_read.description: The App's server may read over mgmt (default `false`).

start_level.description: The lowest level whose members may record (default `none`).

title: MgmtAppRecording
